title: Punishment: Aims, Types & the Death Penalty

flashcard_questions.q: A penalty imposed on someone who has committed a crime, intended to maintain justice and social order.
Punishment that is designed to make the criminal pay for what they have done; an 'eye for an eye' approach.
Punishment that aims to discourage the criminal and others from committing crimes by demonstrating the consequences.

flashcard_questions.a: Punishment that aims to change a criminal's behaviour so they become a law-abiding member of society.
A building where people are held as punishment for a crime, usually for a set period of time.
